context:
Categorize each of the 22 failing queries into: fixable (dialect override),
expected_failure (platform limitation), or needs-investigation. Work through
fixable queries first using ClickHouse override patterns. Window function and
QUALIFY fixes may require subquery rewrites rather than simple function substitutions.
description:
64/450 query failures across 22 unique queries in read_primitives on ClickHouse.
These break into several categories:

Dialect fixes needed:
- any_value_simple, any_value_with_filter: WHERE x = ANY(subquery) → WHERE x IN (subquery) (Pattern F)
- array_length: LENGTH(array_col) mistranslated to lengthUTF8() → should use length()
- statistical_percentiles, intrinsic_appx_median: PERCENTILE_CONT WITHIN GROUP → quantile() (Pattern C)
- statistical_correlation: likely CORR() function differences
- timeseries_trend_analysis, window_moving_frame, window_multiple_orderings: window function syntax differences
- qualify_cume_dist: QUALIFY clause not supported in ClickHouse

Expected failures (not fixable as dialect issues):
- aggregation_groupby_large: Timeout (907s vs 300s limit)
- fulltext_boolean_search, fulltext_phrase_search, fulltext_simple_search: full-text search syntax not portable

Secondary bug: The result JSON shows no error messages for most failures. The ClickHouse
adapter is capturing failure status but swallowing the exception message (Pattern G).
